reason_not_populated_now: Populating this inventory requires running the M1->M15 aggregation over the committed design-span M1 data to produce derived M15 files and their SHA-256 checksums. That aggregation code does not yet exist (it is a gate-5 code-only implementation deliverable) and must be created under the value-pinned tests in design_m15_derivation_manifest.json before any real derivation. Fabricating checksums here is forbidden.

required_schema_per_file.sha256: 64-hex of the derived M15 file bytes

minute_accounting.expected_source_minute_count: int; minutes the approved calendar artifact says should exist for this pair in the certified span
minute_accounting.observed_source_minute_count: int; minutes for which a source record existed
minute_accounting.absent_source_minute_count: int; expected by the calendar, not present in the source
minute_accounting.rejected_source_minute_count: int; present in the source but not usable, because it violated a contract
minute_accounting.usable_source_minute_count: int; canonical, distinct minutes admissible to aggregation
minute_accounting.max_unavailable_gap_minutes: int; longest run of consecutive expected-but-not-usable minutes, measured against the expected calendar
